author: Lennart Demes (ambientCG)
notes: Black/white marbled checker, 4x4 tiles per repeat, thin seams; reads like Armstrong-style marbled VCT. Size not published by ambientCG: estimated so one tile = 12in (0.305 m). Clean scan: add scuffs/grime/wax-dull in shader (roughness mul + dirt mask); per-tile tint jitter still possible via tile ID = floor(uv*4). 2K. No AO map in source.

author: Lennart Demes (ambientCG)
notes: 2x2 ft lay-in acoustic tiles with white T-bar grid, 6x6 tiles per repeat. Published size 3.85 m (0.64 m/tile); set repeat to 3.66 m for true 0.61 m (2 ft) tiles. Albedo is near-white: multiply by a warm yellowed tint and add water stains procedurally. Has AO. 2K. Metalness/emission maps skipped.
